source_note: 函数与序列的上下极限
english_source_note: Limsup and Liminf of Functions and Sequences
callout_id: 函数与序列的上下极限#4
statement_en: A real number $\alpha$ is badly approximable if there exists a positive constant $C(\alpha)$ such that for every rational number $\frac{p}{q}$, $$\left|\alpha-\frac{p}{q}\right|\geq \frac{C(\alpha)}{q^2}.$$ This is equivalent to $$\alpha \in \mathbf{Bad} \iff \liminf_{q\to \infty }q\|q\alpha\|>0,$$ where $\|x\|:=\min\{|x-n|:n\in \mathbb{Z}\}$ denotes the distance from $x$ to the nearest integer.
key_techniques: reformulate rational approximation via distance to nearest integer
use positivity of a limit inferior
convert eventual lower bounds into uniform lower bounds
callout_body:
实数$\alpha$被称之为badly approximable如果存在一个正实数$C(\alpha)$使得任意有理数$\frac{p}{q}$都有$$\left|\alpha-\frac{p}{q}\right|\geq \frac{C(\alpha)}{q^2}$$而这个定义可以等价地写成：$$\alpha \in \mathbf{Bad} \iff \liminf_{q\to \infty }q||q\alpha||>0$$此处$||x||:=\min\{|x-n|:n\in \mathbb{Z}\}$表示$x$与最近的整数之间的距离。

参考[[无理测度的定义以及基本的命题#1.4 与Badly approximable之间的关系]]：

$q||q\alpha||\geq C(\alpha)>0$于是$$\liminf_{q\to \infty}q||q\alpha||\geq C(\alpha)>0$$反过来如果$\liminf_{q\to \infty}q||q\alpha||=A(\alpha)>0$那么根据“命题1.1”及其推论，这意味着至多存在$N$个$q$使得$0<q||q\alpha||<A(\alpha)$那么只要令$B(\alpha):=\min_{1\leq q\leq N}\{q||q\alpha||\}$如此一来只需要令$$C(\alpha):=\min\left\{\frac{A(\alpha)}{2},B(\alpha)\right\}$$那么我们就知道对任意的正整数$q$都有$$q||q\alpha||\geq C(\alpha)>0$$于是$\alpha\in \mathbf{Bad}$。
